description: This file defines a plugin class for plotting volatility-related technical indicators using Plotly. It contains multiple methods to add different volatility indicators such as ATR, Bollinger Bands, Donchian channels, and Keltner channels to a Plotly figure, along with annotations and styling based on theme.

classes.name: Volatility
classes.description: A plugin class for adding volatility indicators to Plotly figures, including ATR, Bollinger Bands, Donchian channels, and Keltner channels.

methods.name: plot_atr(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Adds the Average True Range (ATR) indicator to the Plotly figure as a scatter trace, with an annotation.

methods.name: plot_bbands(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Adds Bollinger Bands (upper, lower, and middle bands) to the figure as scatter traces, with an annotation representing the bands.

methods.name: plot_donchian(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Adds Donchian channel upper and lower lines to the figure, along with a filled area between them, including an annotation.

methods.name: plot_kc(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Adds Keltner Channel upper and lower bounds to the figure as scatter traces, with annotations, supporting different moving average modes.
